name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility - Soil Health Card
benefit: - **Soil Health Card:** Provides a Soil Health Card containing detailed soil analysis results.- **Soil Testing Facility:** Provides free or affordable access to soil testing services.- **Soil Analysis Report:** Provides timely and accurate soil analysis results to farmers.- **Nutrient Recommendations:** Provides customized soil nutrient and fertilizer recommendations based on soil test results.- *
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be residing in India.
